errors.projectClosed: This project is closed (read-only) after its close-out archive: files can be viewed and downloaded, but not uploaded or changed. A system administrator can reopen it.
errors.busy: A close-out archive of this project is being built. Wait until it is finished.
errors.nothingToArchive: There is nothing to archive: no file is in a Published or Archived folder (or Shared, when included).
errors.tooLarge: The archive would hold {{size}} GB, more than the limit of {{max}} GB (CDE_CLOSEOUT_MAX_GB).
errors.noDiskSpace: Not enough disk space for the archive: it needs about {{size}} GB plus a reserve of {{reserve}} GB, {{free}} GB is free.
errors.notReady: The archive is not ready to download.
errors.expired: The download period of this archive is over and its file was deleted. Build a new archive.
errors.archiveFirst: Build a complete close-out archive (no missing or changed files) before closing the project.
errors.reopenAdminOnly: Only a system administrator can reopen a closed project.

readme.title: SiteKeep close-out archive
readme.versionsLatest: the current version of each file
readme.purpose: This package archives the project information model at project close-out (ISO 19650-2:2018, 5.8.1). It keeps the files in the project's folder structure with their metadata, approvals and supersession links, and the project's audit log.
readme.files: the files, in the project's folder structure; older versions as "name (V2).ext"
readme.manifestJson: one entry per version: document code, container, revision, suitability, CDE state, size, SHA-256, uploader, approvals, supersession links, naming standard check (schema {{schema}})
readme.manifestCsv: the same as a table, one row per version (";" separated, UTF-8)
readme.auditCsv: the project's audit log up to entry {{id}}, without IP addresses and browsers
readme.auditVerify: the audit chain check made when the archive was built
readme.sums: SHA-256 of every file in the package
readme.head: Latest audit entry: {{id}}, {{at}}, hash {{hash}}
readme.noHead: The audit log has no chained entries yet.
readme.recordHead: Keep this hash outside SiteKeep: any later change, removal or insertion of an audit entry up to it makes the chain check fail.
readme.check: To check the package: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS (Linux, macOS: shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS). The integrity column of the manifest says whether each file matched the SHA-256 stored when it was uploaded.
readme.problems_one: {{count}} file could not be archived as stored:
readme.problems_other: {{count}} files could not be archived as stored:

integrity.mismatch: content does not match the stored SHA-256
